title: Correlation immunity
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and a natural number $k$, correlation immunity is the property that the real-valued version of $f$ is Fourier regular with parameters $0$ and $k$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube.
caveat: The payload does not define Fourier regularity or the real-valued version of a Boolean function, so their precise meanings cannot be rendered from the supplied information.
